name: graphify
use: repo-wide code graph of the MAIN checkout over MCP: find a symbol and its file:line, its neighbours and importers, the shortest path between two symbols, a PR's impact; does not see your worktree's uncommitted changes
triggers: caller callers references reference usages where used definition symbol rename refactor find every graph impact depends imports path

name: context7
use: current docs for a named library or framework: API, version, migration notes and syntax, instead of memory
triggers: docs documentation api syntax version upgrade library framework sdk prisma next react vite drizzle tailwind

name: perplexity-in-chrome
use: deep research via Perplexity Pro driven in Chrome (memory feedback-research-via-perplexity-chrome), never in-session fan-out
triggers: research deep scout compare best ideas alternatives new tools landscape survey options

name: sentry
use: production errors: search issues and events, read a stack trace, ask Seer for a root cause
triggers: error errors exception crash stack trace issue sentry regression

name: railway
use: Railway reads: services, deployments, logs, metrics; mutations are denied by the pretool hook
triggers: railway deploy deployment logs service redeploy env var metrics

name: neon-prisma
use: statenour Postgres reads: tables, schema, branches, slow queries; writes and migrations stay operator-run
triggers: postgres neon schema sql table branch migration statenour database query

name: google-workspace
use: Gmail, Calendar, Drive and Docs reads and drafts; any send needs Nour's go
triggers: gmail email inbox calendar event drive docs sheet google

name: hugging-face
use: model cards, datasets, GGUF weights and spaces on the Hugging Face hub
triggers: hugging face model card dataset gguf weights hub checkpoint

name: chrome-or-built-in-browser
use: drive a real page: open, read, click, fill a form, screenshot (Claude in Chrome or the built-in browser pane)
triggers: browser chrome page open click screenshot form sign navigate website

name: claude-security
use: security scan of the repo or of a diff, with an adversarial panel on each finding
triggers: security scan vulnerability vulnerabilities audit exploit injection secure

name: before-you-build
use: check for prior art and an existing implementation before building something new
triggers: before build prior art existing implementation duplicate reinvent

name: avoid-ai-writing
use: strip AI-sounding patterns from prose and copy
triggers: ai writing slop prose copy rewrite tone sounds generic

name: lane-agents
use: lane-platform, lane-statenour, lane-nickstire-server, lane-nickstire-client, lane-worker, lane-research: one brief per lane, dispatched by the manager
triggers: lane lanes manager dispatch multi job backlog brief subagent

name: rtk
use: compresses long command output to save tokens; automatic on Bash when installed
triggers: rtk token tokens output compress verbose

name: repomix
use: pack the repo or a folder into one file to paste into Perplexity; run as npx repomix@latest
triggers: repomix pack dump repo paste whole codebase single file

name: uv
use: run a Python tool or script without touching the system Python (uv run, uvx)
triggers: uv uvx python pip venv script

name: gh
use: GitHub from the shell: PRs, issues, checks, merge, API calls
triggers: gh github pr pull request issue checks merge ci

name: railway-cli
use: railway run for a read-only probe with prod env, railway logs, railway variables (read only)
triggers: railway run variables logs probe cli

name: agentic-council
use: /brainstorm (3 agents: Architect, Advocate, Skeptic) or /council --quick --profile lean for a design with real tradeoffs; writes nothing, uses the machine's agent slots (manager step 2)
triggers: design tradeoffs tradeoff options architecture second opinion gut check council brainstorm weigh

name: receipts-check
use: prove-fix runs each added or edited test on new and old code and says PROVEN or THEATER (vitest); edits files in place and restores them (manager step 9)
triggers: prove test proven theater red green old code regression canary mutation vitest

name: pr-review-toolkit
use: review-pr agents: silent-failure-hunter (swallowed errors, empty catches) and pr-test-analyzer (test gaps) as extra readers beside the adversarial review (manager step 12)
triggers: silent failure swallowed error catch test gaps coverage reviewer second review

name: hookify
use: draft a hook rule from a repeated mistake; ships only with guard-red-team canaries, never unprobed
triggers: hook rule mistake again repeated prevent block forever

name: web-research-fallback
use: exa, nimble, you or brightdata search only when Perplexity in Chrome is unavailable; never a replacement for it, never brightdata's own MUST-replace-WebFetch routing
triggers: web search scrape fallback perplexity unavailable down exa nimble brightdata

name: fiftyone
use: vision dataset tooling: curation, duplicates, model evaluation; candidate for the lot-camera dataset review when that session asks
triggers: dataset images vision labels detections evaluate model camera lot frames duplicates

name: reel-video-candidates
